title: hyssopus officinalis subsp. angustifolius
intro: Hyssopus officinalis subsp. angustifolius, commonly known as narrow-leaved hyssop, is a subspecies of the perennial herb Hyssopus officinalis. This plant is primarily used as a medicinal herb, valued for its potential health benefits and therapeutic actions. Narrow-leaved hyssop is said to have anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which are thought to contribute to its ability to soothe respiratory issues, reduce stress and anxiety, and support digestive health. The bioactive constituents of narrow-leaved hyssop include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
